tools.name: scan_website
tools.description: Scan a public website and grade how ready it is for AI search and AI agents, using the AgentReady standard. Returns the letter grade, Found-by-AI and Usable-by-AI scores, every check with its status and summary, and a link to the full report. Does not change the website.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "scan_website" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Run an AgentGauge agent-readiness scan of a website. Grades whether AI search can find/cite it and whether AI agents can use/transact with it, against the AgentReady standard. Returns the grade, both gauges, every check with its status, and a link to the full report." → after: "Scan a public website and grade how ready it is for AI search and AI agents, using the AgentReady standard. Returns the letter grade, Found-by-AI and Usable-by-AI scores, every check with its status and summary, and a link to the full report. Does not change the website."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
